description: The run, job, step and log group times of a GitHub Actions workflow.

panels.title: Run time percentiles
panels.description: The wall time of a successful run of the workflow, with p50, p90 and p95 for each week. A week with a few runs shows a p95 close to its maximum.

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH f(workflow) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN (SELECT workflow FROM ci_runs GROUP BY workflow ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ?1 END), base AS (SELECT date(substr(r.date, 1, 10), 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS week, r.wall_seconds AS v FROM ci_runs r, f WHERE r.workflow = f.workflow AND r.conclusion = 'success'), ranked AS (SELECT week, v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY week ORDER BY v) AS n, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY week) AS total FROM base) SELECT week AS date, MIN(CASE WHEN n >= 0.5 * total THEN v END) AS p50, MIN(CASE WHEN n >= 0.9 * total THEN v END) AS p90, MIN(CASE WHEN n >= 0.95 * total THEN v END) AS p95 FROM ranked GROUP BY week ORDER BY week","params":["$workflow"]}

panels.title: Runs by conclusion
panels.description: The number of runs of the workflow for each week and conclusion.

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH f(workflow) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN (SELECT workflow FROM ci_runs GROUP BY workflow ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ?1 END) SELECT date(substr(r.date, 1, 10), 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS date, r.conclusion, count(*) AS runs FROM ci_runs r, f WHERE r.workflow = f.workflow GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1","params":["$workflow"]}

panels.title: Queue time p95
panels.description: The p95 of the wait for a runner, for each week and operating system.

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH f(workflow) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN (SELECT workflow FROM ci_runs GROUP BY workflow ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ?1 END), base AS (SELECT date(substr(j.date, 1, 10), 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS week, j.os, j.queue_seconds AS v FROM ci_jobs j JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = j.run_id AND r.run_attempt = j.run_attempt, f WHERE r.workflow = f.workflow AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND j.conclusion = 'success' AND j.queue_seconds IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT week, os, v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY week, os ORDER BY v) AS n, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY week, os) AS total FROM base) SELECT week AS date, MIN(CASE WHEN os = 'linux' AND n >= 0.95 * total THEN v END) AS linux, MIN(CASE WHEN os = 'macos' AND n >= 0.95 * total THEN v END) AS macos, MIN(CASE WHEN os = 'windows' AND n >= 0.95 * total THEN v END) AS windows, MIN(CASE WHEN os = 'other' AND n >= 0.95 * total THEN v END) AS other FROM ranked GROUP BY week ORDER BY week","params":["$workflow"]}

panels.title: Log group time
panels.description: The average seconds of one log group for each week and operating system. Use the group variable to pick the group.

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH f(workflow) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN (SELECT workflow FROM ci_runs GROUP BY workflow ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ?1 END), g(name) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?2 = '' OR substr(?2, 1, 1) = '$' THEN (SELECT name FROM ci_step_groups GROUP BY name ORDER BY sum(duration_ms) DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ?2 END) SELECT date(substr(x.date, 1, 10), 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS date, avg(CASE WHEN j.os = 'linux' THEN x.duration_ms END) / 1000.0 AS linux, avg(CASE WHEN j.os = 'macos' THEN x.duration_ms END) / 1000.0 AS macos, avg(CASE WHEN j.os = 'windows' THEN x.duration_ms END) / 1000.0 AS windows, avg(CASE WHEN j.os = 'other' THEN x.duration_ms END) / 1000.0 AS other FROM ci_step_groups x JOIN ci_jobs j ON j.run_id = x.run_id AND j.run_attempt = x.run_attempt AND j.job_id = x.job_id JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = x.run_id AND r.run_attempt = x.run_attempt, f, g WHERE r.workflow = f.workflow AND x.name = g.name GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1","params":["$workflow","$group"]}

panels.title: Job time percentiles
panels.description: The p50, p90 and p95 of the run time of each successful job, for each operating system. The matrix part of a job name, such as " (ubuntu-latest)", is removed.

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH f(workflow) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN (SELECT workflow FROM ci_runs GROUP BY workflow ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ?1 END), base AS (SELECT CASE WHEN instr(j.name, ' (') > 0 THEN substr(j.name, 1, instr(j.name, ' (') - 1) ELSE j.name END AS job, j.os, j.duration_seconds AS v FROM ci_jobs j JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = j.run_id AND r.run_attempt = j.run_attempt, f WHERE r.workflow = f.workflow AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND j.conclusion = 'success' AND j.duration_seconds IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT job, os, v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job, os ORDER BY v) AS n, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY job, os) AS total FROM base) SELECT job, os, MAX(total) AS runs, MIN(CASE WHEN n >= 0.5 * total THEN v END) AS p50, MIN(CASE WHEN n >= 0.9 * total THEN v END) AS p90, MIN(CASE WHEN n >= 0.95 * total THEN v END) AS p95 FROM ranked GROUP BY job, os ORDER BY p50 DESC","params":["$workflow"]}

panels.title: Slowest steps
panels.description: The average seconds that each step takes in a successful run of its job, and the slowest run. A step shorter than a second counts as 0.

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH f(workflow) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN (SELECT workflow FROM ci_runs GROUP BY workflow ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ?1 END), job_runs AS (SELECT CASE WHEN instr(j.name, ' (') > 0 THEN substr(j.name, 1, instr(j.name, ' (') - 1) ELSE j.name END AS job, j.os, count(*) AS runs FROM ci_jobs j JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = j.run_id AND r.run_attempt = j.run_attempt, f WHERE r.workflow = f.workflow AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND j.conclusion = 'success' GROUP BY 1, 2), spent AS (SELECT CASE WHEN instr(j.name, ' (') > 0 THEN substr(j.name, 1, instr(j.name, ' (') - 1) ELSE j.name END AS job, j.os, s.name, sum(s.duration_seconds) AS total, max(s.duration_seconds) AS slowest FROM ci_steps s JOIN ci_jobs j ON j.run_id = s.run_id AND j.run_attempt = s.run_attempt AND j.job_id = s.job_id JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = s.run_id AND r.run_attempt = s.run_attempt, f WHERE r.workflow = f.workflow AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND j.conclusion = 'success' AND s.duration_seconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT s.job, s.os, s.name, round(1.0 * s.total / n.runs, 1) AS avg_seconds, s.slowest AS slowest_seconds FROM spent s JOIN job_runs n ON n.job = s.job AND n.os = s.os ORDER BY avg_seconds DESC LIMIT 40","params":["$workflow"]}

panels.title: Slowest log groups
panels.description: The same for the log groups. A group splits a composite action, and it splits the checkout, into their parts.

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH f(workflow) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN (SELECT workflow FROM ci_runs GROUP BY workflow ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE ?1 END), job_runs AS (SELECT CASE WHEN instr(j.name, ' (') > 0 THEN substr(j.name, 1, instr(j.name, ' (') - 1) ELSE j.name END AS job, j.os, count(*) AS runs FROM ci_jobs j JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = j.run_id AND r.run_attempt = j.run_attempt, f WHERE r.workflow = f.workflow AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND j.conclusion = 'success' GROUP BY 1, 2), spent AS (SELECT CASE WHEN instr(j.name, ' (') > 0 THEN substr(j.name, 1, instr(j.name, ' (') - 1) ELSE j.name END AS job, j.os, x.name, sum(x.duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS total, max(x.duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS slowest FROM ci_step_groups x JOIN ci_jobs j ON j.run_id = x.run_id AND j.run_attempt = x.run_attempt AND j.job_id = x.job_id JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = x.run_id AND r.run_attempt = x.run_attempt, f WHERE r.workflow = f.workflow AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND j.conclusion = 'success' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT s.job, s.os, s.name, round(s.total / n.runs, 1) AS avg_seconds, round(s.slowest, 1) AS slowest_seconds FROM spent s JOIN job_runs n ON n.job = s.job AND n.os = s.os ORDER BY avg_seconds DESC LIMIT 40","params":["$workflow"]}
